playoff.entries: 14th in the Pro League vs 3rd in the Azadegan League
playoff.note: Iran has used this two-legged promotion/relegation tie in recent seasons; the 2026-27 page does not spell it out, but its table legend and the Azadegan intake both imply it.

playoff.entries: 3rd in the Azadegan League vs 14th in the Pro League
playoff.note: Top two promoted directly; 3rd into the play-off. Bottom three relegated to League 2.

stages.name: final
stages.note: the two group winners meet to decide the League 2 title; both are promoted

stages.name: promotion_playoff
stages.note: the two group runners-up meet for a third promotion place

playoff.note: Champion and runner-up of the group-winners' final go up; the runners-up play-off winner takes the third place (2026 intake: Foolad Novin, Naft Masjed Soleyman, Shahin Bandar Ameri).

boundaries.note: Azadegan: top two up, 3rd into a two-legged tie with the Pro League 14th. Pro League: two bottom clubs down directly plus the 14th in that tie.

League 2: both group winners promoted (they also play a final for the title), the two runners-up play off for a third place. Azadegan's bottom three go down and are placed into the two regional groups. League 2's own bottom two in each group (four) drop to League 3. | balanced to keep league sizes after a source conflict.

conflicts.real: the 2026-27 table legend marks 15th-18th as relegation (four places), but only three clubs came up from the Azadegan League
conflicts.note: Recorded as three down (two direct plus the 14th in a play-off), which fits the three-club Azadegan intake. The four-place legend cannot be reconciled with a stable 18-club league, and the 2025-26 season is no guide because the league was expanding then: only Mes Rafsanjan went down, through the play-off, while three clubs came up.

conflicts.real: the general League 2 article says the top two of each group go up (four clubs); the current Azadegan intake shows three
conflicts.note: The four-club rule is older. The 2026-27 Azadegan article names exactly three promoted clubs - the League 2 champion, the runner-up and the play-off winner - so the three-place model is recorded.

notes: The Pro League expanded from 16 to 18 clubs for 2026-27 (16 clubs, one relegated, three promoted). Azadegan is a single table of 16 (30 rounds) with a 3rd-place promotion/relegation play-off; its bottom three drop to League 2. League 2 is a genuinely regional competition: two groups of 14 (28 clubs, 26 rounds each), the group winners meet in a final that decides the title, the runners-up play off for the third promotion place, and the bottom two of each group are relegated to League 3 (level 4, not in our rows). League 2 does not have a national table, so '28 clubs' is two separate 14-club leagues.
